decisions.reason: The firm has invested in a high-resolution printer close to its established portfolio and already lists it publicly, so escalation of commitment favors persisting rather than writing off that visible investment.
The software module was launched with an explicit public announcement and builds on the established offer, making visible commitment and justification pressures strongest to keep it.
Although it targets non-absorbent surfaces, it is still an extension of the established coding portfolio and is publicly mentioned, so the firm will likely persist to justify its investment.
